The GTX780 was around Titan level of performance, and it wasn't until the R9 290 / 290X that AMD pulled back ground in the high end.

Because AMD has effectively (and successfully) spanned 2.5 generations with their 7850/7870/7950/7970 line up, it's hard to gauge just where the GTX760 fits in.
